h1: Saudi Arabia visa from the UK
intro: We help UK residents with Saudi tourist eVisas, business visas and work visas. The tourist eVisa can be used for Umrah outside Hajj season, but only by eligible passport holders. We handle every Saudi Arabia visa, from tourist eVisas to work visas with document attestation.

faqs.a: Yes, through the Saudi tourist eVisa, for eligible passports. We cannot help where your nationality is not eligible for the tourist eVisa.

faqs.q: Can I do Umrah on a Saudi tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes, outside the Hajj season. Hajj requires a dedicated Hajj visa.

faqs.q: How long does a Saudi Arabia visa take?
faqs.a: The tourist eVisa is usually quick, often within days. Work visas take longer, as they need medicals and document attestation.

faqs.q: Can British citizens get a Saudi Arabia visa online?
faqs.a: Yes. British citizens can apply online for the Saudi tourist eVisa.

sections.heading: Saudi tourist eVisa
sections.text: British citizens and many UK residents can apply online for a Saudi tourist eVisa. It is usually a one-year multiple-entry visa allowing stays of up to 90 days, and it allows you to perform Umrah outside the Hajj season. Hajj needs a separate Hajj visa through approved organisers.

sections.heading: Saudi work visas
sections.text: A Saudi work visa starts with your employer in Saudi Arabia obtaining approval. You then complete medical tests, provide a police certificate, and have your degree and other documents attested before applying through the Saudi visa centre. We arrange the attestation of UK documents as part of our service.

sections.heading: Business and family visits
sections.text: Business visitors and family visitors can often use the eVisa or apply for a specific visit visa, depending on nationality and the purpose of the trip. We confirm the right route before you apply.

sections.heading: Saudi Arabia visa: which type do you need?
sections.text: Most holidaymakers and Umrah pilgrims use the tourist eVisa. If you're visiting a Saudi company for meetings, a business visit visa may be needed. Working in Saudi Arabia always needs a work visa, which starts with your employer's approval. Family members joining relatives working in Saudi Arabia need a family visit visa. We confirm which one fits your trip before you apply.

sections.heading: Saudi visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most travel visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you don't need to visit us in person.
